title: 1RB0LE_0LC0RA_1LE0RD_0RB---_0LF0LD_1LA0LF: the fuel a defect needs, and a corrected reduction
text: The earlier conditional theorem assumed every round's defect dies counting from blank tape; that is false (round 2's defect survives), so it was vacuous. Lean now proves the machine reaches round 9 at step 5,848 and never halts if from there each round's defect needs at most one visit, a number given by a short recursion over the round's tape. In the run the defect needs 3 or 4 visits and gets 2<sup>k/2</sup>.
